subject: StratusBank: TAM coverage, on-call escalation & incident comms (playbook submission)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: StratusBank: TAM coverage, on-call escalation & incident comms (playbook submission)

Hi Morgan —

Thanks again for the RFP follow-up call this morning. Per our conversation, attached is a compact submission that covers:
- TAM coverage table (shift windows, geographic overlap, holiday coverage)
- On-call escalation map (who gets paged at each severity)
- High-level incident communications templates for P1/P2/P3

Files attached: TAM_Coverage_Table.xlsx, Incident_Comms_Playbook_v1.pdf, Escalation_Route_Map.png (see links at the bottom).

Quick notes:
- Core TAM coverage is 24/5 (US daytime primary); we provide 24/7 P1 coverage via our escalation rotation and a dedicated night responder for platinum/enterprise commitments.
- Scheduled maintenance and change windows have a 72-hour notice cadence in the contract; for StratusBank we can tighten to 48 hours for critical upgrades — let us know if you want that committed.
- Incident comms templates include a pre-approved legal-safe header; we can swap in your branding if you provide logo and legal ack.

Please flag any gaps and we’ll iterate quickly. If Andre or procurement need the spreadsheet in CSV for ingestion, we can attach that as well.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- TAM_Coverage_Table.xlsx (spreadsheet, 8 rows)
- Incident_Comms_Playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
- Escalation_Route_Map.png (diagram)

Date: 2027-09-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StratusBank: TAM coverage, on-call escalation & incident comms (playbook submission)

Jordan —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the level of detail. A couple of quick clarifying asks from our side:
1) For the night responder: do you have an SLA-backed acknowledgement target? We need to map that to our internal incident response timebox.
2) The escalation map looks good, but can you confirm whether the second-level on-call has the ability to open a mitigation cluster (we need a named role who can trigger the cloud-side rollback)?
3) For legal: is the "legal-safe header" customizable, and can you include the specific phrasing our counsel requested (we'll paste it in a follow-up)?

If you can answer 1–3 and send a CSV version of the TAM table, we can slot this into our SOC/compliance packet and move to inclusion in the SOW.

Thanks —
Morgan Patel
VP, Cloud Security Programs
StratusBank

Subject: Re: StratusBank: TAM coverage, on-call escalation & incident comms (playbook submission)

Morgan / Andre —

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers and next steps below:

1) Night responder SLA: for Platinum enterprise customers we commit to a P1 acknowledgement within 15 minutes and initial triage comms within 45 minutes. We'll include these as SLA bullets in the SOW addendum (can be changed to 10/30 if you require tighter targets and are comfortable with the pricing delta).

2) Second-level mitigation authority: our second-level on-call is empowered to trigger customer-scoped mitigation actions (e.g., cloud rollback or service disable) only when pre-authorized in the customer's runbook. For StratusBank we recommend a two-step authorization: (a) primary on-call confirms incident severity and (b) a named custodian at the bank (or their delegated proxy) provides the authorization token before irreversible actions are executed. We can support JIT authorization via a short-lived token flow integrated with your identity provider.

3) Legal header: yes — we can swap the header text. Please paste the counsel-approved language and our legal team will insert it verbatim; flag any phrases that require an exception.

Attachments included in this reply: CSV version of the TAM table (TAM_Coverage_Table.csv) and a redlined PDF showing the authorization step callouts (Incident_Comms_Playbook_v1_redline.pdf). Links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/stratusbank-support-playbook (master copy).

Next steps:
- Jordan: I will follow up with an SOW addendum draft by Friday that includes the 15/45 SLA.
- Procurement (Andre): please confirm if CSV is acceptable for ingestion or if you need the table in a specific import schema.
- Morgan: paste counsel phrasing for the legal header and I'll route to Legal.

If you'd like a short walkthrough of the playbook with the incident templates, Ben and I can run 30 minutes this week.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
